paper.title: How I learned to stop worrying and love IPv6

submission: Actual PDF form using the legitimate signed-in production Google session. New assessment identity; do not reset or relabel any previous pilot.
questions: Does one authenticated PDF submission durably start the uncapped OpenClaw controller?
Do real host-specific subscription calls retain exact prompts/responses and private original artifacts?
Can the durable worker run at least one registered archived arithmetic check and persist its exact observations?
Can the queue show per-claim stages, prompt history, coverage and blockers on desktop and mobile?
criteria: PDF original hash matches after storage retrieval
Defaults are 10000 aggregate cents, seven elapsed days and max_attempts null
Actual model is gpt-6.1-sol through OpenClaw with no API-key/Bedrock fallback
At least one actual autonomous turn and one completed registered archived check with stored measurements
Original logical/native/provider bytes and canonical controller prompt/response hashes verify after retrieval
Claims with unavailable inputs stay honestly blocked, inconclusive or untested; no forced conclusive label
No duplicate model or experiment identities under concurrent polling
scientific_scope: Reused original IPv6 archived plan with 15 sourced claims and 20 retained campaign definitions. This is exposed archived numerical rechecking, not fresh full-paper review, raw-pcap reanalysis, an independent replication or a new Internet measurement. Individual 192-cell checks do not establish full 1152-cell claim coverage. Broader causal/operational claims remain limited.
comparison: Match observation, complete configuration, metric, units and epochs. Frozen arithmetic criteria and source versions are not tuned for release success. Descriptive coverage only; no inferential interval is supported by these software/archived controls.

resources.verification_stop: Stop active verification after criteria pass or the observation window ends; retain unresolved work and its ordinary application resource limits. A successful experiment is not complete scientific validation.

failure_policy: Preserve original failed/invalid/unknown calls, experiments and feedback. Amend protocol/configuration before follow-ups; never replay an uncertain provider call or rewrite the earlier pilot.
